description: This file defines a highlight function for text pattern matching and highlighting, including diacritic insensitivity, used in the typeahead.js library.

methods.name: hightlight
methods.description: Main function to highlight patterns within a DOM node, supporting options like case sensitivity and diacritic insensitivity.

methods.name: getRegex
methods.description: Constructs a regex pattern from input patterns, considering case sensitivity, word boundaries, and diacritic insensitivity.

methods.name: accent_replacer
methods.description: Replaces characters with their accented counterparts for diacritic insensitivity.
